key.name: keybinding
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut to open the emoji picker
key.description: Keybinding that toggles the emoji picker popup. Default is Ctrl+K. Set to empty in the preferences dialog to free the shortcut.

key.name: default-category
key.summary: Category shown first when the picker opens
key.description: Which tab is active by default when the popup is opened. Use "recent" to land on the recently-used emojis view.

key.name: recent-count
key.summary: Number of recently-used emojis to remember
key.description: How many emojis are kept and shown in the recently-used section.

key.name: recents
key.description: Emoji characters the user has copied, most-recent first.

key.name: skin-tone
key.summary: Default skin tone for applicable emojis
key.description: Skin tone modifier applied to emojis that support skin tones when they are copied. "none" copies the base emoji unchanged.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.summary: Paste the selected emoji into the focused field
key.description: When an emoji is selected, type it into the currently focused text field (synthesised Shift+Insert). The emoji is also placed on the clipboard either way. Disable this if you only want the emoji on the clipboard so you can paste manually.
